points.description: Labels the data points with positive and negative labels (e.g. +1/-1 or +/-).
Initializes the weights randomly (or with arbitrary initial values).
Gives the perceptron update rule: if <w,x> <= 0 (the point is misclassified / not on the correct side), update w <- w + eta*x(n); equivalently, with labels y, w <- w + eta*y*x when y<w,x> <= 0.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the update rule is present but the misclassification condition is missing or wrong.

levels.says: Gives an update of the form w <- w + eta*x (or w <- w + eta*y*x) but omits the condition <w,x> <= 0 or uses a wrong condition/sign.

points.description: Repeats the update over all epochs until the weights do not change much / until convergence; may state that convergence is guaranteed because the data is linearly separable.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if repetition is mentioned but no stopping condition or convergence statement is given.

levels.says: Mentions repeating over epochs but does not say to stop when the weights stop changing or that the algorithm converges.

rubric.notes: Full marks require the perceptron update with its misclassification condition, plus initialization, labeling and repetition until convergence. Part marks are given for an update rule without the condition or for repeating without a stopping/convergence statement. No marks for an answer that lacks the perceptron update rule.
